decisions.decision: The Commissioners approved and signed the privilege fee assessments for two properties connecting to the sewer system

budget_items.topic: Privilege fee assessment for Stone Farm property
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Privilege fee assessed for 786-796 Mass Ave (Stone Farm) after two betterments; fee has been paid
budget_items.quote: 786-796 mass ave, which was the old stone farm, had paid 2 betterments and were now assessed a privilege fee of $23,102.96, which has been paid.

budget_items.topic: Privilege fee assessment for Pratt Street property
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Privilege fee assessed for 67 Pratt Street which is already connected to the sewer system
budget_items.quote: 67 pratt st is already connected and was assessed a privilege fee of $6,998.74.

public_comment.speaker: Brett Ramsden
public_comment.topic: Appreciation for departing Commission member Arthur Katis
public_comment.quote: in regard to arthur katis leaving the commission, brett pointed out that arthur had been a good addition to the commission. he brought a different view to the board as a customer and asked a lot of questions that many of their customers may be wondering about.

public_comment.speaker: Andrew Valliere
public_comment.topic: Recognition of 20-year Commission history and staff appreciation
public_comment.quote: andrew noted that it has been 20 years since the formation of the sewer commission and he wanted to recognize the work of all the past and present commissioners. he acknowledged that brett has been a commissioner for 6 years and jane has been doing the minutes for 9 years.

topics.topic: Special Town Meeting warrant article for Sewer Pump Station Procurement
topics.resolution: warrant article wording approved for presentation at November 17 Special Town Meeting
topics.quote: that the sewer commission vote to authorize the development and advertising of a comprehensive procurement for the sewer pump station operation, maintenance, emergency services and construction capital repair work to be combined into a single multi-year contract

topics.topic: CTE Operations and Maintenance Contract status
topics.quote: andrew reported the cte contract is extended until 11/25/26 so they can get everything completed before their contract expires.
andrew noted the event went very well and was well attended. the weather was good and the kids had fun.
